_comment: One entry per public service. The homepage service list, the navigation, the footer and each module page are all built from this file. status: planned | building | live. Nothing is live yet.

modules.name: Saaz Check
modules.line: A vetted garage inspects the car before you pay. The report is saved to the car's history.
modules.intro: Get a free code for the car, take it to a Saaz partner garage, and get a written report with photos. Buyer and seller decide who pays, or split it.
steps: Get a free code
Register with your phone number. One code per car, tied to its chassis number.
Visit a partner garage
The garage checks the code and gives you the Saaz price.
Get the report
Checks and photos on a link you can share on WhatsApp.
depends: Inspection checklist agreed with the garages

modules.name: Vehicle history
modules.line: Enter a chassis number or plate and see every Saaz inspection of that car.
modules.intro: Every Saaz inspection is saved against the car's chassis number. Before you buy, look the car up and see what earlier inspections found.
steps: Enter the chassis number or plate
From the car or its logbook.
See the record
Every Saaz inspection of that car, newest first, with dates and findings.
Book a new check
If the record is old or empty, get a code and book an inspection.
depends: Chassis number and plate matching rules

modules.name: Inspected cars
modules.line: Only cars that passed a Saaz inspection, each shown with its report.
modules.intro: A car is listed only after it passes a Saaz inspection. Every listing shows its report, so you can see the condition before you call.
steps: Browse by make, price, body type or year
Prices in UGX.
Read the report on the listing
Findings, photos and the inspection date.
Contact the seller
By WhatsApp. Saaz never asks you to pay into a personal number.
depends: Sellers with cars that passed an inspection
Standard photos taken at the garage

modules.name: Sell your car
modules.line: Inspect first, then list your car with its report attached.
modules.intro: Buyers trust a car that has a report. Get your car inspected at a partner garage, then list it on Saaz with the report attached.
steps: Get a code for your car
Choose who pays: you, the buyer, or both.
Pass the inspection
At any Saaz partner garage. Standard photos are taken there.
List it
Your listing shows the report. Buyers contact you by WhatsApp.

modules.name: Partner garages
modules.line: Vetted garages in Kampala, each with a public rating.
modules.intro: Saaz does not employ mechanics. Inspections happen at partner garages that Saaz has checked. Every garage and inspector has a public rating.
steps: Find a garage near you
In Kampala.
See its rating
From buyers whose car it inspected, and from upheld disputes.
Book with your Saaz code
The garage gives you the Saaz price.

modules.name: Import desk
modules.line: A full landed-cost quote in UGX before you commit, and an inspection when the car arrives.
modules.intro: Tell us the car you want. Saaz quotes the full landed cost in UGX, including taxes and clearing, before you pay anything. The car is inspected at a partner garage when it arrives.
steps: Request a quote
The car you want, or one you have found abroad.
See the full cost
Car, shipping, taxes, clearing and the Saaz fee, in UGX.
Track it to Kampala
Then an arrival inspection, saved to the car's history.
depends: Tax and levy table checked against URA

modules.name: Finance
modules.line: An introduction to a lending partner, only with your consent.
modules.intro: If you need a loan for a car, Saaz can introduce you to a lending partner. We pass on your details only when you say yes. Saaz never asks for your bank statements or income.
steps: Say you want finance
On a listing or an import quote.
Agree to share your details
Name and phone number only.
The lender contacts you
The lender decides and sets the terms.

modules.name: Become a partner garage
modules.line: Get inspection bookings from buyers. The better your reports, the higher you rank.
modules.intro: Saaz sends buyers with a Saaz code to partner garages. Every partner is checked before going live, and rated after every job.
steps: Get checked
Business papers, named inspectors, equipment, and a test inspection.
Sign the partner terms
The checklist, the Saaz price, and what you owe for a missed fault.
Take bookings
Check each Saaz code, inspect, and enter the report on your phone.
